evaluation.safety_evals: The developer notes that Falcon-7B-Instruct was trained mostly on English data and therefore may not generalize appropriately to other languages, and that because it was trained on large-scale web corpora it may carry stereotypes and biases commonly encountered online.

identity.name: ✨ Falcon-7B-Instruct
identity.summary: Falcon-7B-Instruct is a 7-billion-parameter causal decoder-only model developed by TII, initialized from Falcon-7B and fine-tuned on a blend of chat and instruction datasets.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card gives only high-level training data description (fine-tuned on a mixture of chat and instruct datasets) and no detailed documentation of data composition, filtering, or evaluation process.

possible_risks.description: Unrepresentative data occurs when the training or fine-tuning data is not sufficiently representative of the underlying population or does not measure the phenomenon of interest. Synthetic data might not fully capture the complexity and nuances of real-world data. Causes include possible limitations in the seed data quality, biases in generation methods, or inadequate domain knowledge. Thus, AI models might struggle to generalize effectively to real-world scenarios.
possible_risks.justification: Card states model was trained mostly on English data and therefore may not generalize appropriately to other languages, indicating training data not representative of all potential users/languages.

possible_risks.description: Decision bias occurs when one group is unfairly advantaged over another due to decisions of the model. This might be caused by biases in the data and also amplified as a result of the model's training.
possible_risks.justification: Card states large-scale web corpora may carry stereotypes and biases commonly encountered online, which can unfairly advantage/disadvantage groups in model decisions.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not provide traceable provenance for the chat/instruct mixture used in fine-tuning, only a vague description of the blend.

specifications.model_size: 13.4 GiB of safetensors weights (14,434,402,976 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: Falcon-7B-Instruct is a fine-tuned version of Falcon-7B, adapted on a mixture of instruct and chat datasets.
training_context.training_data: Falcon-7B-Instruct was fine-tuned from Falcon-7B on a mixture of chat and instruct datasets.
